description: List the Quran text editions you can request: Arabic text, translations in many languages, tafsir and transliteration. Filter by language code (for example en, ur, fr) and/or type (translation, tafsir, quran, transliteration). Returns the ids to pass to the verse tools.

language.description: ISO language code such as en, ur, fr, ar

query.description: part of a name, for example sahih or maududi

name: list_editions

id.description: edition id to pass to the verse tools, for example en.sahih

type.description: quran, translation, tafsir, transliteration and so on
